description: A handful of wrinkled grey mushrooms grown in somebody's ventilation duct.

events.text: [trip]A cold wave rolls up from your stomach, the nausea that always comes first. You yawn, and yawn again.[/trip]
[trip]The queasiness breaks like a fever and everything goes soft and significant.[/trip]
[trip]The walls take a slow, deliberate breath.[/trip]
[trip]The floor is a carpet of soft breathing moss now. It doesn't mind you standing on it.[/trip]
[trip]Every surface is faintly patterned with eyes, all of them kind.[/trip]
[trip]You can hear the colour green. It sounds like your grandmother's kitchen.[/trip]
[trip]Time pools in the corners of the room like warm honey.[/trip]
[trip]A shaft of light bends toward you and asks, without words, if you're okay. You think you might be.[/trip]

effects.onset_message: The nausea goes, and everything looks strange and interesting.

overdose.message: It's too much. You're terrified, and it won't stop.

phases.comedown_message: The visions fade, and things start to look normal again.
phases.comeup_message: Your stomach turns over and a heaviness settles into your limbs. Something is coming on.
phases.end_message: You come down gently. You feel empty, like you've been crying.
phases.peak_message: The nausea passes. Everything seems to mean something.

effects.take_line: You chew the mushrooms down, stems and all.

name: psilocybin
